items.question: What proportional measures should the projection and the base have in this division?
premises: The projection is assigned a measure of one part.
The base is assigned a measure of five parts.
Both measures apply within the prescribed structural division.
items.inference: Therefore the projection and the base stand in a one-to-five proportional ratio.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referents of kampakaṃ and jagatī in this context remain technical.
items.plain_english: The projection should measure one part, and the base should measure five parts.
